notes:
New
• Drop a video whose style you want. Solis hears every sound effect in it and recognises the same sound used again and again ("a whoosh ×9, on cuts").
• It finds those exact sounds in your pack, even when the video plays them under voice and music. Then your edit uses them for the same kind of moments: Long Form prefers them, and Competition Intros us
• Sounds your pack doesn't have still teach the style: Solis guesses what kind they are (impact, whoosh, pop, ding or riser) and where they're used (on cuts, on zooms, right after a line, in pauses).
• Zooms: Solis now also finds punch-in cuts (a jump to the same shot, closer), and your zooms push as far as the reference's do.
• Faster study: the picture is read on the graphics card while the sound and speech are analysed.
• Several videos from one channel merge into one style, so one odd video doesn't decide it.
• References you added before this update: choose Re-analyze to hear their sounds.
• Solis doesn't download from YouTube. A link still gives the title, channel and thumbnail.
• To learn a video's sounds and zooms, drop the video file. For your own videos, use YouTube Studio > Content > Options > Download.
• One box to start: add clips, say how it should feel, and walk away. You get a live timer, a "your edit is ready" notification, closing the window doesn't stop the edit, and tonight's queue edits video
